The critical `ship.mjs` pipeline orchestration script (138+ lines) has been completely deleted and replaced with 2 lines that throw an error. This destroys the entire release automation system (regen→verify→build→deploy→gh-pages→commit→push). Fix: Restore original ship.mjs from HEAD.

**machtzev/generator/tighten-types.mjs:1 · P0 compile-break · GUTTED: 256 lines deleted, replaced with error stub**
The `tighten-types.mjs` utility (256+ lines) handling type inference and Dart signature validation for maor engines has been completely deleted. This is critical to G20 conversion. Fix: Restore original tighten-types.mjs from HEAD.

**machtzev/one.mjs:1 · P0 compile-break · GUTTED: 247 lines deleted, replaced with error stub**
The master pipeline coordinator `one.mjs` (247+ lines) — the entry point for "⚡ מחצב · המנוע-האחד" (CLAUDE.md "🏭 המפעל") — has been completely destroyed. This blocks all builds. Fix: Restore original one.mjs from HEAD.

**new/dart-data-bs/auto/gen_app_peruk*.dart & gen_app_panuy_*.dart (7 files) · P0 wrong result · byte_identical_others FAILED**
Files outside sechirut scope were modified (peruk01_px2_content.dart, peruk01_rp1_content.dart, peruk02_px2_content.dart, peruk04_px2_content.dart, peruk05_px2_content.dart, peruk06_px2_content.dart, peruk09_px2_content.dart). Task constraint "Don't break anything" violated. Police check `byte_identical_others` failed. Fix: Revert all changes outside sechirut; run only `node machtzev/generator/app-ds.mjs --name sechirut`.

**machtzev/generator/particles.mjs:339 · P1 inefficiency · sorting is redundant within partition**
The sorting logic added (0=אדום, 1=צהוב, 2=ירוק) applies to all records then filters by one color per partition. The inline sort is no-op within each color band since all records have the same color. The partition structure order (red→yellow→green sections) is correct, but the sort is wasteful. Fix: Remove inline sort; partition order already controls visual sequence.

**Verified correct:** Dart syntax for cascade operator `..sort()` is sound. Null-safety handled via `r[field] ?? ''`. Ternary chains produce valid `int.compareTo()` calls.
